text:
maria (partnerships): Heads upZenith & Nebula sent parallel ratecards. We need canonical fields back from them to run apples-to-apples cost sims + decide marketplace vs direct listing strategy. Who can own?

jon (finance): I can run the sims but need exact usd/hour for list, reserved tiers, spot, and any marketplace revenue share. Also need min commit granularity for amortization (hours or GPUs).

kevin (infra-ops): From infra side: we need spot preempt policy (grace + notify), eviction survival metrics (p50/p90), and time-to-recover to a warm reserved instance. If vendors can't measure p90, at least provide eviction histogram bucketed by minute up to 60.

amir (partner-ops): Also ask for SI integration constraints: are there joint-support SLAs for marketplace-deployed customers? That impacts how we price white-glove SI bundles.

suresh (procurement): I'll hit both vendors. We need their CSV to include region, sku, on-demand_usd_hr, spot_usd_hr, reserved_tiers (tenor:effective_usd_hr), min_commit_units, marketplace_fee_pct, si_margin_pct, preempt_policy_desc.

emma (legal): If marketplace_fee_pct or si_margin_pct exceed our thresholds we'll need to loop in legal before announcements. Please tag me on any contractual language that references "co-marketing" or revenue share.

vendor-sync-bot: Zenith uploaded: https://zenith.supply/ratecard_aug2026.csv (2.1MB). Nebula uploaded: https://nebula.partners/ratecard_aug2026.csv (1.8MB). Both include reserved tiers but formats differ.

maria (partnerships): OK format harmonization is the pain-point. Proposed canonical header we send back to vendors:

sku,timestamp,region,on_demand_usd_hr,spot_usd_hr,reserved_tiers_json,min_commit_units,marketplace_fee_pct,si_margin_pct,preempt_grace_s,preempt_notice_s,eviction_p50_s,eviction_p90_s,availability_90d_pct

kevin (infra-ops): Good. Suggest replacing reserved_tiers_json with a pipe-delimited string like "1m:0.9|3m:0.8|12m:0.6" to avoid nested JSON. Add field "typical_memory_gb" if available.

jon (finance): Add "list_price_usd_hr" if on_demand is a discounted list vs marketplace list. We also need "billing_increment_hours" so we can compute rounding effects.

amir (partner-ops): For SI bundles include "si_support_level" (basic/premium/whiteglove) and "si_onboarding_days". We'll use these to model uplift.

suresh (procurement): I'll send the harmonized schema and an example row so vendors map correctly. Example row (please copy when you message vendors):

`g6x.16,2026-09-01T00:00Z,us-east-1,3.50,0.78,1m:3.15|3m:2.45|12m:1.90,100,0.06,0.15,120,15,300,900,99.4,256`

maria (partnerships): Nice. Also note: if vendors want to charge for synthetic workload profiling, ask them to price it separately and give a short justification (what metrics they'll deliver). We'll decide if it's worth the incremental cost.

emma (legal): One more: if they request exclusivity windows for go-to-market, we need redlines. Flag any exclusivity ask immediately.

vendor-sync-bot: Nebula replied: can provide eviction_p50/p90 and availability_90d_pct; reserved tiers as requested; SI margin fields are vendor-provided approximations. Zenith replied: can provide those plus 48h pod logs on request (extra fee). Zenith confirms preempt_notice_s=15.

jon (finance): Plan: once canonical CSVs are in, I'll run three sims: aggressive spot mix, balanced, reserved-heavy. I'll output blended usd/token and break-even commit points.

kevin (infra-ops): I'll convert eviction histograms -> survival curves and compute expected lost token fraction for each fallback latency scenario.

amir (partner-ops): I'll draft two go-to-market notes: marketplace listing (with revenue share examples) and SI package pricing. Will hold public PR until finance + legal sign off.

suresh (procurement): Sent the canonical schema to both vendors. ETA for harmonized CSVs: 48 hours. Dropping links when ready.

maria (partnerships): Thanks. Quick ask: keep this thread for vendor links only. Create a separate thread for the GTM announcement plan.

vendor-sync-bot: Nebula uploaded harmonized CSV: https://nebula.partners/harmonized_ratecard_aug2026.csv. Zenith requested a short follow-up on their reserved_tiers formatting; they will post final CSV in 6 hours.

jon (finance): Great. Once both are in I'll share a short deck with sensitivity charts. If anyone wants a slice (e.g., APAC-only), ping me.

maria (partnerships): Closing loop we won't go public until finance break-even and legal clears co-marketing. Thanks team.
